items.t: In Oakridge, Vancouver, houses sold at a median of $2,619,000 across 8 sales, and the middle half closed between $2,449,500 and $2,847,500. The median house sat 41 days and sold for 91.9% of list.
Oakridge, Vancouver: 10 townhomes sold at a median of $1,540,000, with the middle half between $1,472,500 and $1,637,500. The median townhome took 28 days to sell and closed at 94.9% of list.

21 condos sold in Oakridge, Vancouver at a median of $908,000 (middle half $628,571 to $1,215,000). A typical condo in Oakridge, Vancouver spent 42 days on the market and closed at 97.2% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Oakridge compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Of 17 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Oakridge ranks 15th highest at $2,619,000; the range is $1,549,000 (University) to $4,817,500 (Shaughnessy). Marpole ($1,800,000) sits just below and Mount Pleasant VW ($2,625,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Oakridge have the 7th highest median of 18 Vancouver West sub-areas, $1,540,000. False Creek is lowest at $850,000 and Coal Harbour highest at $2,255,000. Cambie ($1,502,500) sits just below and South Cambie ($1,592,500) sits just above.

Of 21 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Oakridge ranks 8th highest at $908,000; the range is $613,500 (Marpole) to $1,228,000 (Coal Harbour). Dunbar ($890,000) sits just below and Shaughnessy ($922,500) sits just above.
